title: NHTCU meets ONI/DOJ; extradition threat of 70 years

tellings.quote: November and then they threatened extradition then on paper it was 70 years in jail.

plain: In November 2002, Britain's National Hi-Tech Crime Unit, a police unit for computer crime, met with the Office of Naval Intelligence and the US Department of Justice about Gary McKinnon, and the Americans then threatened to have him extradited to face what was 'on paper 70 years in jail.' McKinnon, the British hacker who got into US military and NASA computers, tells Michels this as what happened to him. It shows how seriously Washington treated his case.
